videos.headline: Indiana dismantles Oregon to reach first-ever national title game
videos.description: Indiana trounces Oregon to win the Peach Bowl and advance to the College Football Playoff National Championship game.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Indiana dismantles Oregon to reach first-ever national title game) 2026/01/10 ESHEET

videos.headline: Indiana starts off Peach Bowl with an electric pick-six
videos.description: Oregon QB Dante Moore goes to pass but is picked off by Indiana's D'Angelo Ponds, who takes it to the crib for a touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Indiana starts off Peach Bowl with an electric pick-six) 2026/01/10 ESHEET

videos.headline: Dante Moore's TD pass to Jamari Johnson helps Oregon respond
videos.description: Oregon QB Dante Moore slings a touchdown pass to Jamari Johnson to help the Ducks tie the score.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Dante Moore's TD pass to Jamari Johnson helps Oregon respond) 2026/01/10 ESHEET

videos.headline: Indiana reclaims lead on Fernando Mendoza's TD strike
videos.description: Indiana QB Fernando Mendoza lobs a perfect touchdown pass to Omar Cooper Jr. to give the Hoosiers the lead.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Indiana reclaims lead on Fernando Mendoza's TD strike) 2026/01/10 ESHEET

videos.headline: Indiana scores TD after bizarre Dante Moore fumble
videos.description: After Indiana recovers a fumble by Dante Moore, Kaelon Black punches it in for the Hoosiers a few plays later.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Indiana scores TD after bizarre Dante Moore fumble) 2026/01/10 ESHEET

videos.headline: Charlie Becker makes sensational leaping grab for an Indiana TD
videos.description: Indiana QB Fernando Mendoza lobs it to Charlie Becker in the end zone, who makes an incredible leaping catch for the score.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Charlie Becker makes sensational leaping grab for an Indiana TD) 2026/01/10 ESHEET

videos.headline: Indiana pours it on with its 5th TD of the first half
videos.description: Fernando Mendoza's touchdown pass to Elijah Sarratt gives Indiana a 35-7 lead in the first half.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Indiana pours it on with its 5th TD of the first half) 2026/01/10 ESHEET

videos.headline: Fernando Mendoza tosses 4th TD of the Peach Bowl
videos.description: Indiana QB Fernando Mendoza finds a wide-open E.J. Williams Jr. in the end zone for a touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Fernando Mendoza tosses 4th TD of the Peach Bowl) 2026/01/10 ESHEET

videos.headline: Oregon's 71-yard run sets up a short TD
videos.description: Oregon RB Dierre Hill Jr. rushes for 71 yards, setting up a short Jay Harris touchdown a few plays later.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Oregon's 71-yard run sets up a short TD) 2026/01/10 ESHEET

videos.headline: Indiana keeps up the pressure as blocked punt sets up another TD
videos.description: Indiana comes up with a big blocked punt, setting up another touchdown pass from Fernando Mendoza.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Indiana keeps up the pressure as blocked punt sets up another TD) 2026/01/10 ESHEET

videos.headline: Kaelon Black's TD puts exclamation point on Peach Bowl for Indiana
videos.description: Kaelon Black finds a hole and speeds to the end zone for a touchdown to give Indiana a 56-15 lead.
